decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's thermoforming portfolio and had its own page through 2019, so the option is cheap to hold and there is no evidence it has failed.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a core, low-carrying-cost material for dental labs with steady demand, so dropping it would release few resources and forgo ongoing value.

The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, which signals lower prominence, but it costs little to keep as a complement in the lab and earmold workflow, so holding the option remains rational.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are still uncertain after the related earmold line was removed, but the segment has growth potential and is supported by the firm's digital manufacturing, so the option is worth more than its modest carrying cost.
